September 6, 1938.

JOURNAL DE SHANGHAI

IMPORTANT CONSULAR ORDINANCES PROMULGATED IN FRENCH CONCESSION

The following regulations have been promulgated
by the French Consul-General :-

Regulations Governing Headmen of Alleyways or Buildings

Article 1. - From October 1, 1938, usufructuary
proprietors or owners of alleyways or buildings divided into
several apartments or their responsible managers must employ
for each alleyway or occupied building a headman who may be
a private watchman, a rent collector or one of the principal
tenants.
The headmen must register with the
Police and will be issued with a card of identity.
Whenever a headman leaves his
employment for any reason, he must be replaced within eight
days.
Article 2. - Apart from the special duties with
which they have been entrusted by their employers, the head-
men must
(a) Keep a list of tenants and sub-tenants with dates of
arrival and departure.
(b) Maintain cleanliness in the alleyways and buildings
especially in the matter of the removal of ordure.
(c) Report within 24 hours to the Police of the district
any case of death in the buildings over which he has
control.
(d) Furnish to the Police the names of persons possessing
firearms or who are engaged in the trafficking of arms,
opium and other narcotics, or who are conducting gambling
and information of all acts against peace and order.
Article 3. - When a headman meets with difficulties
in the execution of his duties, he should inform the Chief of
the Police Station in the district so that proper measures
might be adopted.
Article 4. - If the Police for some reason makes
a complaint of a headman, the owners or responsible managers
must remove him within eight days.
Article 5. - Any breach of these Regulations
whether committed by the owner or the responsible manager
or by the registered headman will be punished with a fine
of from $1 to $50.

1938年9月6日。

《上海日报》

法租界颁布重要领事条例

以下规章已由法国总领事颁布：

弄堂或房屋负责人管理规章

第一条. - 自1938年10月1日起，被分割为若干单元的弄堂或房屋的用益物权人或业主，或其负责管理人，必须为每条弄堂或每栋有人居住的房屋雇用一名负责人，该负责人可以是私人巡更、收租人或主要租户之一。
负责人必须在警方登记，并将获发身份证。
凡负责人因任何原因离职，必须在八天内予以替换。
第二条. - 除雇主委托其履行的特殊职责外，负责人必须
(a) 保存一份租户及分租户名单，并注明入住和搬离日期。
(b) 保持弄堂和房屋的清洁，特别是清除粪便等污物。
(c) 在其管辖的房屋内发生任何死亡案件时，须在24小时内向辖区警方报告。
(d) 向警方提供持有枪支者、从事武器、鸦片及其他麻醉品贩运者、开设赌博者的姓名，以及所有破坏和平与秩序行为的情报。
第三条. - 当负责人在执行职务时遇到困难，应通知辖区警察局局长，以便采取适当措施。
第四条. - 如果警方因某种原因对某负责人提出投诉，业主或负责管理人必须在八天内将其撤换。
第五条. - 任何违反本规章的行为，无论是业主、负责管理人还是已登记的负责人所为，均将被处以1至50美元的罚款。

Have ordered and do order as follows:-

Article 1 - From October 1, 1938, beneficial
proprietors or owners of alleyways or buildings divided into
several apartments or their responsible managers must employ
for each alleyway or occupied building a headman who may be
a private watchman, a rent collector or one of the principal
tenants.

The headmen must register with the Police and will
be issued with a card of identity.

Whenever a headman leaves his employment for any
reason, he must be replaced within eight days.

Article 2 - Apart from the special duties with which
they have been entrusted by their employers, the headmen
must
(a) Keep a list of tenants and sub-tenants with dates of
arrival and departure.
(b) Maintain cleanliness in the alleyways and buildings
especially in the matter of the removal of ordure.
(c) Report within 24 hours to the Police of the district
any case of death in the buildings over which he has
control.
